registered_sources.description: European Central Bank FX reference rates.
ENTSOG Transparency Platform infrastructure, flows, capacities, IPs, and outages.
Gas Infrastructure Europe AGSI storage and ALSI LNG data.
National Gas NTS transportation tariff references for explicit-leg route costing.
BBL Company public interconnector capacity tariff references.
Interconnector UK public charging statement and capacity tariff references.
Gasunie Transport Services Dutch transmission tariff references.
French transmission tariff references for NaTran/GRTgaz/Terega context.
German gas transmission tariff references for THE market-area routing.
Fluxys Belgium transmission tariff references for ZTP and border routing.
Spanish CNMC/Enagas gas access toll and tariff references.
European Energy Exchange gas market prices and screen observations.
EEX-shaped simulated gas market prices injected into the runtime DB at a continuous worker cadence for decision-support testing.
ICE OCM live within-day and day-ahead market observations.
ICE OCM-shaped simulated within-day and day-ahead marks injected through the runtime DB path at a high-frequency worker cadence.
Trayport screen and broker market data.
Trayport-shaped simulated broker-screen marks injected through the canonical runtime DB path at a realtime worker cadence.
ICE Endex futures settlements: TTF and NBP gas, EUA and UKA carbon, API2 Rotterdam coal and power. Licensed; imported from the customer's ICE Report Center export until a connector is licensed.
CME NYMEX Henry Hub futures settlements. Licensed (CME DataMine).
NGX (ICE) Canadian gas: AECO-C/NIT indices and settlements. Licensed.
US EIA open data: Henry Hub daily spot price (public domain; free API key). Reference for US LNG export economics.
Platts licensed gas price assessments and curves.
ICIS Heren licensed gas assessments and reference prices.
ICIS Heren-shaped simulated daily assessment rows injected into market observations.
Argus licensed gas assessments and market references.
Kpler licensed LNG and market intelligence feeds.
Template for a licensed weather vendor the deployment has not chosen yet; no connector reads it. ECMWF Open Data is the implemented weather source.

ENTSO-E Transparency Platform day-ahead power prices, load, and wind, solar and gas-fired generation: the drivers of gas burned for power. Free; requires a registered security token; attribution: ENTSO-E.

Elexon Insights (BMRS) Great Britain half-hourly gas-fired and wind generation, national demand and the APX market index price: the GB side of gas burned for power, which ENTSO-E does not carry. Free, no key; attribution: Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right.

National Gas data portal: Great Britain storage stock, withdrawal and injection, LNG tank stock and send-out into the NTS, per gas day. The GB side of the storage and LNG balance, which GIE AGSI/ALSI leave empty. Free, no key; open data with attribution to National Gas Transmission.
Bank of England SONIA overnight fixing (Interactive Database series IUDSOIA): financing and early-cash valuation in GBP. Free; attribution.
ECB euro short-term rate (€STR) from the ECB Data Portal: financing in EUR.
Federal Reserve Bank of New York SOFR from the Markets API: financing in USD for LNG and cross-currency contracts. Free; attribution.

REMIT urgent market messages: planned and unplanned outages of gas production, storage, LNG and transmission, imported from the desk's inside-information platform export (scripts/ops/import_remit_umm.py).
ECMWF Open Data IFS 0.25° 2 m temperature forecasts. Actual public source under CC BY 4.0; attribution: ECMWF.

Model endpoint for operator-reviewed analysis: any OpenAI-compatible chat-completions service (DeepSeek by default; provider, URL and model are set by EUROGAS_NEXUS_LLM_PROVIDER_NAME, _BASE_URL and _MODEL). A service, not a data feed: it has no freshness or ingestion schedule.

WM/Reuters (LSEG) London closing and intraday spot fixes, imported from the desk's licensed export (scripts/ops/import_fx_fixings.py --source WMR). The fix most LNG contracts name; ECB reference rates are not a substitute.
Bloomberg BFIX fixes, imported from the desk's licensed export (scripts/ops/import_fx_fixings.py --source BFIX).
